purpose: Primary-source legal, technical, and coverage audit of Persian ASR, conversational, disfluency, code-switching, and forced-alignment corpora.

corpora.name: Neyshekar V6 (Persian Speech Dataset)
corpora.DURATION: 99.02 h total (190 speakers); selectively ingested 6.9830 h speaker-disjoint val (3.1358 h, 26 spk) + test (3.8472 h, 30 spk)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Human read-speech transcripts; 24.44% informal-register text prompts (still read speech, NOT spontaneous conversation)

corpora.name: SpeechDataAI / Spirelight Persian (Farsi) Conversational Speech Dataset
corpora.AUDIO_AVAILABLE: COMMERCIAL_PURCHASE_ONLY (HF repo is dataset card only; free sample requires company email request)
corpora.WORD_TIMESTAMP_AVAILABLE: UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_SAMPLE_INSPECTION (advertised as time-aligned transcripts; utterance vs word granularity unverified without sample)
corpora.NATURAL_CONVERSATION: ADVERTISED_YES (500 h, 50 speakers, dual-channel two-person spontaneous conversations recorded in Iran)
corpora.DISFLUENCY_COVERAGE: UNVERIFIED_WITHOUT_SAMPLE (expected in spontaneous speech but requires sample verification)
corpora.DURATION: 500 hours available; advertised $65/hour (minimum order / quote not committed)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Human-verified time-aligned advertised; unverified without inspecting free sample

corpora.name: ELRA-S0415 Persian Speech Corpus
corpora.license: ELRA Commercial / Research Agreement (paid quote required)
corpora.NATURAL_CONVERSATION: PARTIAL_MIX (scripted/read + podcasts + radio + phone dialogues across 89 speakers)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Manual native transcription; mixed genres (not purely spontaneous)

corpora.name: ELRA-S0112 FarsDat (Persian Speech Database)
corpora.license: ELRA Commercial VAR (~EUR 2,500 member / EUR 5,000 non-member)
corpora.WORD_TIMESTAMP_AVAILABLE: DERIVABLE_FROM_PHONEMIC_SEGMENTATION (phoneme/phone boundaries + word boundary mapping used in Taraneh paper for 6,039 utts / 36,634 gold word intervals)
corpora.DURATION: 300 speakers, 10 dialects, read sentences & isolated words (~6,039 aligned utterances in Taraneh benchmark)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: High-precision manual phonetic/phonemic segmentation of read speech; NOT conversational/disfluency/code-switching

corpora.name: ELRA-S0380 Large FarsDat
corpora.license: ELRA Commercial VAR (~EUR 25,000 member / EUR 30,000 non-member)
corpora.DURATION: ~73 hours, 100 speakers, formal newspaper read speech (22,050 Hz)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Formal read speech only; prohibitive EUR 25k-30k commercial cost for early-stage AvaPardaz

corpora.name: Persian Speech Corpus (en.persianspeechcorpus.com)
corpora.DURATION: ~2.5 hours, 1 speaker, formal Tehrani read speech
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: TTS studio read speech; fails both commercial license and conversational/speaker diversity

corpora.name: LDC2019T11 Corpus of Conversational Persian Transcripts
corpora.DURATION: ~20 hours transcript text only (0.0 hours audio included)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Linguistic text resource only; CANNOT be counted as ASR audio evaluation dataset

corpora.name: PartAI/PSRB (Persian Speech Recognition Benchmark)
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Expert native transcripts reported, but zero commercial license / speaker consent clearance

corpora.name: areffarhadi/persian-media-eval
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Research-only evaluation set; legally barred from commercial product evidence

corpora.name: saeedzou/persianvox
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: ASR-filtered rather than human-verified transcripts; manual gate blocked automated audit

corpora.name: MahtaFetrat/GPTInformal-Persian (Mana-TTS)
corpora.DURATION: 6+ hours studio TTS read speech of GPT-4o generated informal prompts
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Scripted single-speaker TTS read speech aligned with aeneas; MUST NOT be used to claim natural conversational coverage

corpora.name: Reza2kn/visualears-golden-6669
corpora.ANNOTATION_QUALITY: Published by Shenava-1 authors; potential ecosystem correlation with Shenava-Rizeh evaluation protocol
